text: dsh-width-tiers 是面向 DSH Web 的对话宽度插件，在 shell.overlay 界面层加入悬浮档位按钮和选择菜单。它使用应用原生对话宽度变量，让内置拖动手柄继续调整宽度，并提供标准、中等、宽、超宽、全宽和自定义六种选择。用户可通过菜单选档，也可拖动原生边缘保存自定义宽度；选择会在下次访问时恢复，并同步到其他标签页。全宽档会收起左侧栏，标准档恢复应用默认宽度。菜单支持键盘导航，界面文字随应用语言切换。适合希望在 DSH 网页端快速调整阅读空间的用户；不需要额外账号或 API 密钥。

dsh-width-tiers adds a DSH Web menu with six conversation widths: standard, medium, wide, ultra, full and custom. It uses native controls, restores choices across visits and tabs, and collapses the left sidebar in full mode. Keyboard navigation and localized labels are included.
我想把 DSH 网页里的聊天区域调宽一点。
能不能给对话区提供几档固定宽度让我切换？
我希望用拖动边缘设定并记住自己的聊天宽度。
让网页端下次打开时继续使用上次选的对话宽度。
在一个标签页改了聊天宽度，其他标签页也跟着更新。
想一键让对话铺得更开，同时收起左侧边栏。
Let me switch my DSH Web conversation between several readable width presets.
I want a custom chat width that I can set by dragging and use again later.
dsh-width-tiers 的功能「宽度档位」：在悬浮菜单中选择标准、中等、宽、超宽或全宽等对话宽度。选择后插件通过应用原生宽度轴应用档位，标准档则交还默认宽度。
dsh-width-tiers 的功能「自定义宽度」：选择自定义档后可按提示拖动对话区原生边缘；直接拖动边缘也会切换到自定义档，并把最终宽度保存为下次可选的值。
dsh-width-tiers 的功能「状态恢复与跨标签同步」：插件载入时恢复已保存档位，并监听浏览器 storage 变化；用户在其他标签页更新档位时，本页会采用新值。
dsh-width-tiers 的功能「键盘操作」：打开档位菜单后，可用上下方向键移动焦点、Home 和 End 跳到首尾，Escape 关闭菜单并将焦点还给按钮。
dsh-width-tiers 使用浏览器本地存储记录档位和自定义宽度；卸载时会清理其拥有的宽度偏好。

Chat content-width tiers for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.

English | 中文
dsh-width-tiers README · Introduction：

dsh-width-tiers README · Tiers：| Tier | Content width | Sidebar |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Standard 标准 | App default: `max(680px, min(column × 0.64, 920px))` | unchanged |
| Medium 中等 | 1120px | unchanged |
| Wide 宽 | 1280px | unchanged |
| Ultra 超宽 | 1400px | unchanged |
| Full 全宽 | `max(640px, column − 176px)` | collapsed to icon rail |
| Custom 自定义 | width recorded from a native drag | unchanged |

dsh-width-tiers README · Tiers：Fixed and custom widths are clamped by the app to
`max(640px, column − 176px)`; the standard tier follows the app default
(680–920px). On a narrow window a wider fixed tier therefore behaves like
`full`, and the menu shows the reachable maximum for fixed tiers (1280px
reads 640px on an 800px column).

dsh-width-tiers README · Features：- Uses the app's native width axis (`--dsh-chat-user-width` and
  `dsh.conversation.contentWidth`), so the built-in drag handles keep working.
- Persists the selected tier and restores it on the next visit.
- Follows **Settings → Language** (中文 / English / 日本語 / Español / Français / Deutsch / Русский / Português), including the Settings plugin card's title and summary (`locale/<lang>.json`).
- Menu supports ArrowUp/Down, Home/End, Escape and Tab, with focus restoration.
- Tier changes sync across tabs.
- Respects `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- Never touches the right panel. Only `full` collapses the left sidebar, and
  you can expand it again at any time.

dsh-width-tiers README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-width-tiers
```

Restart `dsh web`, then hard-refresh the page. A six-bar picker appears at the
bottom-right.

For a local checkout:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-width-tiers
```

dsh-width-tiers README · Usage：- Click the picker and choose a tier.
- Picking `Custom` before the first drag opens a guide at the right edge; drag
  a native handle to record a width.
- Dragging any native handle switches to `Custom`; the plugin steps aside while
  you drag.
- `Standard` clears the width preference and returns to the app default.
- `Full` collapses the left sidebar; the icon rail stays available.

dsh-width-tiers README · How it works：- Mounts the picker into the frame-wide `shell.overlay` slot; the plugin fiber
  owns the controller lifetime, so no listeners or timers outlive it.
- The controller publishes an immutable snapshot (tier, menu, guide); the React
  picker renders it and dispatches actions, so the view can remount without
  rebuilding observers.
- Locates the conversation body that declares `--dsh-chat-content-width`
  (prefers `[data-conversation-content]`, skips the right sidebar's embedded
  conversation), then writes `--dsh-chat-user-width` on its parent.
- Stores the configured target in the app preference; only the inline width is
  clamped to `max(640px, column − 176px)`.
- Watches the column with `ResizeObserver` so `full` follows sidebar, rightbar
  and window changes.
- Drives panels through `ctx.layout` and registers copy through `ctx.locale`.

dsh-width-tiers README · Compatibility：- DSH Web 0.2.x with a `web` profile (`shell.overlay` slot and `slots` service).
- Width axis checked against DSH 0.2.2-alpha.3: 640px floor, 176px handle
  budget, `--dsh-chat-*` variables, `data-width-handle`, layout/locale services.
- Narrow screens: the picker hides while alpha.3's sidebar drawer
  (`data-sidebar-drawer`) is open and follows the on-screen keyboard.

dsh-width-tiers README · Development：```bash
pnpm install
pnpm build        # src/ -> lib/ (host entry + loader-wrapped client bundle)
pnpm typecheck
pnpm test         # vitest: controller (jsdom) + picker component suites

dsh-width-tiers README · Development：The sources live in `src/` (`src/index.ts` is the no-op host entry, the
feature lives in `src/client/`); `lib/` is the built, published payload. The
vitest suites import the sources directly: the controller runs under jsdom and
the picker is rendered with Testing Library, so no live DSH instance is
required. `verify:client` checks the built bundle contract. Development needs
Node 22+ and pnpm.

dsh-width-tiers README · Notes：- Wider fixed tiers are clamped on narrow windows.
- A custom width dragged on a narrow window is clamped by the app before it is
  recorded.
